description: Performance — REST p50/p95 latency, throughput, memory delta over a synthetic load. Default thresholds are agentdeck-tuned (proxy is local, sub-millisecond budgets unrealistic for production SaaS). Override per project by recording your own thresholds via PERF-EXEMPT lines and adjust the template, OR fork the template into process/test-targets/perf-<project>.json.

gates.name: perf.p95LatencyMs
gates.description: REST endpoint p95 latency under synthetic load. Default ceiling 500 ms — tune per project.

gates.name: perf.throughputRps
gates.description: Sustained requests-per-second over the load window. Default floor 50 rps — tune per project.

gates.name: perf.memoryLeakDeltaMb
gates.description: RSS delta between start and end of the load window. Default ceiling 50 MB — tune per project. Indicates a leak when the load test ends but memory does not return.

gates.name: perf.errorRate
gates.description: Fraction of requests that errored under load. Hard ceiling 1 %.
